args: Nightly antigravity-3d variant factory. Read the variant queue at .agy3d/variants/queue.json in the workspace (a JSON list of {asset, stage, variants, target_engine}); if it is missing or empty, reply 'nothing queued' and stop. For each queued asset, create the requested number of variants as parameter-only Scene IR patches with apply_scene_ir on a copy of its USD stage (never edit the source stage), following the parametric-kitbash and pbr-material-forge skills. Gate every variant with the usd_verifier subagent; export only variants whose verdict is PASS (Tier-1 ok, Tier-1.5 >= 3.4) with export_engine_package. Finish with one line per variant: <asset>/<variant>: PASS|FAIL <tier15> <package path or blocker>.
description: Every night at 02:17 UTC, starts a conversation that turns the queued assets in .agy3d/variants/queue.json into QA-gated parametric variants and exports the ones that pass.
